title: Full Stack Engineer
summary: Full stack work on the business system of a large agricultural cooperative, covering agronomy, grain contracts and settlements, feed, energy and food.
highlights: Built and maintained modules for sales orders, invoices, pricing, delivery schedules, advances and settlements, front end to database.
Wrote the money-critical logic: settlement amounts, deferred settlement reversals, month-end prices and delivered-but-unsettled values.
Developed pricing automation endpoints and optimized heavy queries with advanced filters.
Kept data in sync between the new system and the cooperative's existing services.
Helped start the next-generation API: database migrations and seeds, Swagger docs, auth integration tests and CI with GitHub Actions.
growth: Went from feature work to owning financial calculations and test and CI infrastructure in a system the business runs on.
